name: Aiba Rin
source:
A graduate student, Naoki's older sister.
Star Sign: Libra
Hobby: Teasing her younger brother
Likes: Organic Food
Dislikes: Shots, Fatty Food

The protagonist's upperclassman at university.
Unlike her little brother she's friendly and outgoing.
